MLX RTX 3090 TI vs M3 Ultra using Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-bf16

Looking at results of this match in my previous article Qwen3.5-35B-A3B UD-Q3_K_XL 3090 vs M3 Ultra with Llamacpp I decided to try with a more common ground: MLX with Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-bf16.
Some lessons learnt:
I've used Cuda 12, 12.9 to be precise, I was having issues with earlier version
pip install mlx[cuda12] is your friend
Don't use WSL on Windows, apart from the various issues connecting to ssh and more, you have slightly lower performance.
TLDR: 3090 TI wins!
Process to gather data has been quite long but simple to replicate, just execute following commands for batch size 1,2,4,8,16,24,32 and I then created chart in a ChatGPT session directly.
 
I wasn't used anymore to noise, heat and power consumption generated by a single 3090 😂
 
BTW we have again a clear winner again, matmul not in hardware is clearly limiting Apple Silicon chips, but I'm sure will see a different story with upcoming M5 chipset.
🥇 3090 TI (by far in prompt processing, slightly less in generation)
🥈 M3 Ultra 512GB 80 GPU cores
This chart shows the Speedup Ratio on Promt and Generation as you can see there is quite a gap.
